purpose: qualify URM-native K1 online-softmax attention against a competitive fused-attention upstream (native replacement, not dispatch overhead)

comparator.scope_note: flash_attn is not installable in this torch 2.14/cu130 + nvcc 12.9 environment; SDPA is the available competitive fused-attention upstream. Budgets and tolerances unchanged.

methodology.comparison: URM-native K1 online-softmax kernel vs SDPA fused attention; the two share no kernel
methodology.correctness_comparator: SDPA plus an independent eager attention oracle
methodology.timed_work: one native plan call or one upstream call, optionally followed by output backward; prefill and decode run under no_grad
methodology.sampling: paired interleaved native/direct calls, order alternates, synchronized wall timing
methodology.overhead: median of per-pair (native-direct)/direct fractions with bootstrap CI
methodology.gate_basis: the 95% confidence-interval upper bound must meet the budget
